subject: Competitive ledger and OKR alignment — prep for leadership review
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Competitive ledger and initial OKR ask

Team — quick leadership note ahead of QBR prep. Pulled together a short ledger of market moves over the last 10 days that I think have direct OKR implications. High-level summary first, details and asks below. Attachment: pricing_tracker_v4.xlsx; link to deep notes in Drive.

Summary (impact tiered):
- Tier 1 (urgent): Two competing providers moved aggressive list pricing on hosted inference — 15–25% cuts on token pricing for long-context models. Likely to pressure our hosted usage growth targets and inform go-to-market discount bands.
- Tier 2 (near-term): At least one vendor published a ~13B model optimized for streaming latency (release notes attached). This affects our latency-differentiation messaging and infra benchmarking for Dedicated.
- Tier 3 (monitor): A cloud marketplace partner has soft-launched a reseller bundle with add-on security attestation; could change channel motion for Private.

Immediate asks (OKR alignment):
1) Growth/Revenue OKR owners: review the pricing_tracker_v4.xlsx and comment on proposed competitive discount guardrails by EOD Monday (2026-11-08). We need to finalize recommended list vs committed pricing ranges.
2) Product/Platform OKR owners: confirm whether current Dedicated latency SLOs and kernel-optimization roadmap cover the new streaming-optimized model class — call out gaps.
3) GTM: evaluate whether channel bundles require a separate Private offering SKU or a contract addendum.

Attachments: pricing_tracker_v4.xlsx (snapshot of competitor price changes + quick model matrix). Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_snapshots

Notes on signals that matter for QBR slides:
- If we accommodate a price response, we should quantify unit economics impact at the token level and propose offset levers (batching, cache guarantees, quantized variants).
- If the new model advances latency for streaming, we should request an accelerated kernel prioritization (2-week sprint) and estimate cost to push to Dedicated.

I'll collect responses and produce a one-pager for the leadership QBR. Ping me if you want a quick sync.

— Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Product Strategy — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Competitive ledger and initial OKR ask

Thanks Markus — useful consolidation. Quick datapoints from the field:
- Our enterprise AE covering Ava Systems flagged that the marketplace reseller bundle is being positioned as an "all-inference plus compliance" package; they're pushing it to some regulated accounts. That could accelerate channel risk for our Private motion.
- On pricing: a handful of small-mid customers are already asking for credit-based pilot pricing tied to throughput.

Action: I'll add a short note in the pricing tracker about pilot credits and channel exposure.

Question: when you call out a 2-week kernel sprint, do you have specific models or sequence-length profiles we should prioritize? If we can call that out now, we can scope the engineering PRD.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Nov 2026 08:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Competitive ledger and initial OKR ask

Markus / Laura — adding product implications and an attached short log (model-release-log-notes.pdf) with a recommended priority list. Key points:
- The new ~13B streaming-optimized model shows steady-state latency improvements at 2–4 token generation compared to our baseline for 1–2k context runs. Practical implication: prioritize kernel paths that reduce per-token overhead for short-window streaming (chat assistants, tool-calls).
- Proposed prioritization for Dedicated kernel work: 1) streaming-optimized kernels (short-window hot path), 2) KV cache eviction improvements for long-context workloads, 3) quantized mix for mid-tier models.

OKR proposals (short):
- Platform Reliability OKR: Add metric — median streaming-response latency (20–150 token responses) under p95 load, target 20% improvement in next quarter.
- Cost Efficiency OKR: Model routing optimization — aim for 12% unit-cost reduction via batching/caching policy experiments.

Attached: model-release-log-notes.pdf; I've also updated pricing_tracker_v4.xlsx (sheet: recommended_responses). Drive: DOC-4321

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 07 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Competitive ledger and initial OKR ask — alignment and next steps

Appreciate the quick inputs. Summary of next steps and owners (for the QBR one-pager):
- Pricing response and pilot credit framework: owner Laura Bennett — update pricing_tracker_v4.xlsx by 2026-11-09 COB. (Attachment: updated tab expected)
- Platform sprint request (2-week fast track): owner Karthik Iyer — scope doc and sprint request by 2026-11-10. Karthik to include specific model sequence profiles (short-window streaming).
- Channel/Private motion risk assessment: owner Jordan Blake — quick channel-risk slide (impact assessment + recommended contract language) by 2026-11-10. Jordan, coordinate with AVA Systems AE if helpful.

I'll compile these into a one-pager and circulate by Monday morning for leadership review. If we need an escalation on price parity, we'll surface to GTM leadership and request a controlled discount band.

Small housekeeping: I'm attaching the two artifacts I referenced earlier and will refresh the Drive after Laura's update.

Attachments: pricing_tracker_v4.xlsx; model-release-log-notes.pdf

Thanks — Markus
— Markus Klein
VP, Product Strategy — Redwood Inference
